# Vendored copy

This directory is a vendored (non-submodule) copy of:

- Repo: https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/AgentIdeaBench.git
- Commit: `39a310db1a21c83f71455565d05f485933f648bd`
- Vendored on: 2026-09-16

Its own `.git` directory was removed so it commits as a plain copy of files
rather than a broken git submodule reference. To pick up upstream changes,
re-clone and diff manually rather than expecting `git submodule update` to
work here.
